motivation: The parent fixed cohort passed every English efficacy/audit/censoring gate but failed the locked Japanese-safety gate: JA_TEN mean Japanese NLL was 1.1355% worse than JA_TJA versus a 1% maximum. This prospective one-shot test asks whether halving hidden-teaching strength preserves the original efficacy requirement while satisfying the original safety requirement. It is not a reinterpretation or rescue of the parent verdict.
model_and_schedule: Identical to protocols/natural_ja_en_s2_hidden_teacher_r1_2026-09-06.json except hidden distillation loss weight is 0.5 instead of 1.0.
metric: Identical seed-specific no-extra-phase1 reference-defined 80-20 English performance interval and interpolated condition span used in the parent protocol.
primary_pass: span(JA_TEN) - span(JA_TJA) < 0 in at least 9/10 fixed fresh seeds; exact one-sided sign p <= 0.05
mean saving 1 - span(JA_TEN)/span(JA_TJA) >= 0.05 across all ten fixed seeds
mean Japanese eval NLL after phase1 for JA_TEN <= 1.01 * mean Japanese eval NLL after phase1 for JA_TJA
all frozen-corpus, source-language, fixed-byte-tokenizer, fresh-seed, common-random-number, and execution audits pass
no primary seed is censored at the fixed 600 English-update limit
secondary_not_required_for_primary: post-phase1 Japanese NLL relative to ordinary JA_nat
stopping: Exactly these ten seeds and hidden weight 0.5. No rescue seeds, no additional hidden-loss weights, no threshold relaxation, no model or teacher-budget change, and no corpus substitution after fresh outcomes. If this test fails, stop S2 hidden-weight tuning in the current project sequence.
interpretation_if_pass: A lower-strength target-aware S2 hidden-teaching intervention can satisfy the same predeclared English-efficiency and Japanese-retention utility criterion in this domain-limited corpus. The parent weight1.0 study remains FAIL and target-unaware S0/S1 generality remains unestablished.
interpretation_if_fail: Do not continue tuning hidden-teaching strength in this project sequence. Retain the parent result as evidence for a target-aware English benefit with a Japanese-specialist tradeoff, not as a deployable safe curriculum.
